# Test fixtures

Tiny inputs for tests and for the CI build (`uv run siyak-data build --profile fixtures`),
so that CI needs no network access.

## `cache/`: excerpts of the pinned source files

| File | Content | Taken from (pinned sha256) |
|---|---|---|
| `tanzil/quran-uthmani.xml` | surahs 1, 97, 112, 113, 114 | `sources/tanzil` `quran-uthmani.xml` (`8c5aeae2…0417`) |
| `tanzil/quran-simple-clean.xml` | surahs 1, 97, 112, 113, 114 | `sources/tanzil` `quran-simple-clean.xml` (`140787b7…b1fe`) |
| `tanzil/quran-data.xml` | the whole file | `sources/tanzil` `quran-data.xml` (`8867c1d8…5c7a`) |
| `en.pickthall/en.pickthall.txt` | the same five surahs and the header | `sources/translations/en.pickthall` (`4aabbfa9…3cc7`) |

The excerpts are **whole lines copied unchanged** from the pinned files: the
XML prolog with Tanzil's full copyright block, the `<quran>` element and the
complete `<sura>` elements of the listed surahs. No verse text is altered, as
Tanzil's terms require ("verbatim copies … CHANGING IT IS NOT ALLOWED"; the
copyright block must be included). `tests/test_fixtures.py` checks that every
fixture verse is identical to the pinned file when that file is in `.cache/`.

## `sources/`: fixture copies of `source.toml`

Identical to the real files except for the sha256 of the excerpts. The NOTICE
files are copies of the real ones.

## `cache/morphology.qac/`: SYNTHETIC, not QAC data

The Quranic Arabic Corpus may only be copied verbatim as a whole file, so no
excerpt of it is committed. `cache/morphology.qac/quranic-corpus-morphology-0.4.txt`
is **synthetic test data** in the same format, generated by
`make_synthetic_qac.py` from the Tanzil fixture text: mechanical segmentation
(`وَ` → `w:CONJ+`, `ٱل` → `Al+`), placeholder tags, lemmas and roots. It is not
linguistically correct and must never be used as data. Tests against the real
QAC file run only when it is in `.cache/morphology.qac/`.

## `cache/ar.jalalayn/`, `cache/ar.razi/`: excerpts of Quranpedia dumps

| File | Content | Taken from (pinned sha256) |
|---|---|---|
| `ar.jalalayn/tafsir-book-272.json.gz` | surahs 1, 97, 112, 113, 114 | `sources/tafsir/ar.jalalayn` (`20be5cc1…f3e4`) |
| `ar.razi/tafsir-book-352.json.gz` | surahs 97, 112, 113, 114 (al-Fātiḥa alone is 940,000 characters) | `sources/tafsir/ar.razi` (`5b1e232e…0a9b`) |

Source: Quranpedia.net (https://quranpedia.net), dump 2026-10-20. The
Quranpedia data license allows republishing part of the data as a dataset with
this credit and the dump version. The excerpt keeps the file's `license`,
`book` and `schema` and the complete entries of the listed surahs, unchanged;
only the JSON whitespace and the gzip header differ. `make_tafsir_excerpts.py`
writes them from `.cache/`, and `tests/test_fixtures.py` checks every entry
against the pinned dump when it is there.

The Quranpedia-specific steps that these excerpts do not exercise (copy labels,
unpaged duplicates, exclusions, moves) are tested with small synthetic dumps in
`tests/test_quranpedia.py`.
